text:
Elaine Chen: Quick sync — draft outreach + SLA for inbound design-partner candidates. Putting in thread for feedback.

Mike Torres: Nice — thanks. Can you paste the templates and the expected response SLA?

Elaine Chen: Sure, two templates below (short outbound + longer follow-up). SLA we propose: initial reply within 48h, qualification call within 7 days for high-fit.

```Subject: Redwood Private pilot invite — quick ask
Hi <Name>,

We’re running a small pilot for Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem inference). Based on X, we think your team could benefit. 30–45 min call? We offer early access + implementation support.

Reply YES if interested and we’ll send details.
```

```Follow-up (if no reply ~3 days):
Hi <Name>,

Following up on my note. If you’re not the right contact please point me to who owns infra/ML infra.

Thanks — Elaine
```

Jess Patel: Scoring rubric idea: fit(0-5) product maturity(0-5) data sensitivity(0-5) timeline(0-3). >12 = high priority. Thoughts?

Tara Nguyen: Love the rubric. Add integration complexity (0-2) so we can bucket implementation effort for Dedicated vs Private.

Sam Walker: For SLA automation, can we trigger a DM to the recruiter if no reply in 72h? Also suggest canned calendar links in the first reply.

Ravi Singh: For cohort sizing — propose max 8 active pilots per quarter. We should cap by eng capacity and SE support. Also require NDA signed before data access.

Elaine Chen: Agreed on 8. On NDA — legal wants executed before we share infra configs. Add that to the intake checklist.

pm-bot: New form submission: ACME Robotics — initial score 13, high data sensitivity.

Mike Torres: Re: intake checklist columns: company, contact, score, data_sensitivity, expected_start, nda_status, assigned_se, notes.

Jess Patel: Can someone add these columns to the shared sheet and add a filtered view for "ready to onboard" (score>=12 and nda_status=executed)?

Sam Walker: I'll add it now and create the automation for recruiter DM + Slack notif -> #product-ops.

Tara Nguyen: One more: define success criteria per pilot: 1) integrated in prod sandbox, 2) quantifiable perf target (latency/cost improvement baseline), 3) feedback loop engaged (2 organized eval sessions).

Elaine Chen: Perfect. I'll update the playbook doc and send a short note to @sales + @solutions. Please add any blocking items here.

Mike Torres: No blockers from my side. :thumbsup:

Jess Patel: Can we run a 1-week recruiting sprint next Tue to fill Q3 slots?

Elaine Chen: Yup — scheduling now. Thanks everyone.
